design_condition: The building closes the school complex toward the south and extends the existing playground axis through the volume to connect the entrance with the southern green spaces and sports fields.

positive.statement: The clear building consistently implements the idea of a schoolyard surrounded on all sides.
The access axis is connected through the building to the southern green spaces and sports fields.
The basic levels and day school have direct exits to outdoor areas.
The two-story day school provides the desired division of rooms for different children's activities.
The upper-floor structure is well thought out.
The classrooms are very well lit.
The project impresses with its clear and radical approach to the schoolyard.

negative.statement: The entrance area from the side path appears too narrow.
The outdoor-space design remains somewhat vague, despite its potential for further development.
Some classrooms are too far from the common sanitary facilities.
The corridor area on the upper floor appears too spacious.
The full-glass facade fails to meet the primary energy and ecological requirements.
The internal design lacks the same clarity and consistency as the external approach.
The generally oversized rooms make the volume appear unfavorably inflated.
